title: Durable Gap Recovery, Evidence Integrity & Deployment Continuity

implementation_summary.durable_gap_recovery: Implemented transactional recovery architecture in DurableGapRecoveryStore. Gaps are only committed after atomic append, fsync, and read-back durability confirmation.
implementation_summary.recovery_journal: Separate append-only journal (recovery_candles_BTCUSDT_5m.jsonl) with continuous SHA-256 hash chaining. Never rewrites or inserts into original live capture ledger.
implementation_summary.idempotency: Subsequent recovery invocations for already committed gaps detect existing records and return ALREADY_COMMITTED without generating duplicate evidence entries.
implementation_summary.restart_reconstruction: Engine boot reconstructs continuity from both raw_candles.jsonl and recovery_candles.jsonl, seamlessly bridging recovered intervals across restarts.
implementation_summary.rest_adapter_wiring: LiveCaptureService automatically wires BinanceSpotRestAdapter when Approval 3 is authorized, resolving the defect where unrecovered gaps were skipped.
implementation_summary.research_eligibility_guards: Strictly requires >= 288 contiguous closed candles with zero unrecovered gaps in window. Preserves separation between collection health, contiguity, and research eligibility.

deployment_continuity.immutable_image_versioning: Procedure documented using commit SHA tags (cbe-080-shadow:sprint11-02d-<short-sha>) alongside mutable Coolify references.
deployment_continuity.volume_protection: Target volume zgit1s3n1acdtqtsxp0s44vj_cbe-080-live-capture-data verified. Preserves all 1875+ historical entries. Staging mounted :ro, Live Capture mounted :rw.
deployment_continuity.network_preflight: Automated idempotent verification for bridge network zgit1s3n1acdtqtsxp0s44vj.
deployment_continuity.config_drift_detection: deploy/shadow_v080/verify_deployment_preflight.py provides non-mutating validation of Dockerfile, entrypoint, volume, and safety flags.
deployment_continuity.rollback_procedure: Zero-data-loss rollback procedure documented; persistent volume is never wiped or replaced during rollback.
